name: kenken
description: 聪明格 · KenKen（Calcudoku / Mathdoku）— 零猜测算术笼推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用四条局部规则就能推到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js tools/*.mjs tools/scenarios.js; do if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "check: 未落地，跳过 $f"; continue; fi; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK

author: z-biz-game
